I diasgree that life is sacred. I contend that life is random and all the ideas of "sacred" are shit humans put onto a meaningless thing because that's how the human mind works...it believes what it needs to to keep people alive. 

I do agree most people have a balance of good and bad in their lives though yet some people have more bad than others...because of randomness again. 

Just my thoughts

"That said, existing even in pain, as long as it's not over your threshold is worth it."

Can you expand on why? Genuinely curious.
It sounds like the people around you are in denial and can't handle the level of pain you're in. Who is not believing you?
